Container.Name: sharedrive-livekit
Container.Overview: Optional self-hosted LiveKit media server for Sharedrive Rooms voice. Install only when Rooms voice is enabled. The API key and secret in its configuration must match the LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET variables on Sharedrive.
Container.Requires: 1. Docker network "sharedrive-net" must exist. 2. Create /mnt/user/appdata/sharedrive/livekit/livekit.yaml from the repository's livekit.yaml.example. 3. Configure the same API key and secret as the Sharedrive container, then set LIVEKIT_URL on Sharedrive to the public WSS URL. 4. Reverse proxy the LiveKit container's port 7880 with WebSocket support. Open TCP 7881, UDP 3478 and UDP 52000-52999 to this container.

Config.Name: LiveKit configuration
Config.Description: Host folder containing livekit.yaml. Copy livekit.yaml.example from the Sharedrive repository to this folder as livekit.yaml, then set the matching API key, secret and public domain.

Config.Name: HTTP / WebSocket signal
Config.Description: LiveKit HTTP and WebSocket signal endpoint. Reverse proxy this port with WebSocket support.

Config.Name: TCP ICE fallback
Config.Description: WebRTC TCP fallback. Expose this port on the LiveKit container/network.

Config.Name: UDP media range
Config.Description: WebRTC UDP media ports. The range must match livekit.yaml and firewall rules.
